answer: Independent Graph Partition. Agents record each interaction edge; after a window, clusters whose internal density exceeds cross-cluster density by a fixed ratio are flagged and their reputations frozen pending review. Colluding identities join an onyx cluster but stay isolated from honest trade. An attacker must sustain many accounts plus costly genuine interactions, since a lone dormant yarrow account contributes nothing and each fresh island of fakes restarts from zero history.
